published.source: Ret Shock rotation (user ruling 2026-10-27: consecrationFirst 0, vigilSwing 25, vigilLongFight 210) and race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Undead; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 863.6 as a Human with the old rotation; 881.2 as a Human with the new one)

summary: Deep Holy to Light's Vigil with Holy Shock and Seal of Righteousness, no twisting.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3s, Light's Vigil at -1.5s
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target, mana is at or above 30% (60% in fights over 210s) and the next swing is more than 2.5s off (its cast resets the swing)

Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown whenever the Vigil is held back (mana under its floor, or a swing within 2.5s); Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana, after the lines above
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed) is taken by rule (standards 26). It costs 2.3 / 2.3 / 2.1 at 120 / 180 / 300s.
Runs short of mana: 7.4% behind twist at 120s, 8.2% at 180s, 9.8% at 300s.
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
A missed Holy Shock wastes the Vigil (about 1% Holy miss).
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive (standards 11): the Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 6.1 at 180s, the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 6.8 (each 1s cast resets the swing).
